claims.text: Length answers use the exact international definitions, such as 1 inch = 25.4 millimeters, and show 6 significant digits.
Weight answers use the exact pound, 0.45359237 kilograms, and an ounce of one sixteenth of a pound.
Volume answers use the exact US gallon, 3.785411784 liters, and its exact parts: quart, pint, cup, fluid ounce, tablespoon and teaspoon.
Temperature answers are exact: 32 F is 0 C, 0 C is 273.15 K, and nothing goes below absolute zero.
Speed answers use the exact mile, 1609.344 meters, so 1 mph is 1.609344 km/h.
Every answer is rounded half up to 6 significant digits, once, at the very end.
Math is exact fractions of whole numbers, so exact answers such as 5 miles to 26,400 feet never drift.
Messy typing never gives a wrong number, NaN or a crash.
A bad entry gets a calm message in plain words that names the field.
